title: Unsupported High-Availability and Zero-Latency Assumption
description: Tests discovery of unvalidated critical operational assumptions regarding third-party/legacy reliability (100% uptime, zero downtime windows, sub-50ms SLA).

expectedRequirements.statementPattern: .*operates with 100% network uptime.*responds synchronously within 50 milliseconds.*

expectedFindings.rationale: System design relies on unverified, high-risk assumptions of 100% network availability and sub-50ms latency for an on-premise legacy mainframe with no fallback mode or circuit breaker.
